title: cotema spiralis
intro: Cotema spiralis, commonly known as the "Spiral Cotoneaster", is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. This shrub is known for its ornamental value, with its spiral-shaped branches and white flowers in late spring, which turn into red berries in autumn. The health benefits of Cotema spiralis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antitumor, and antiviral activities.
